image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of stratified rock layers. The rock exhibits vertical weathering patterns and erosion channels. In the lower left foreground, green trees and vegetation cling to the slope. At the bottom right, a body of water is visible with a small boat or structure near the shore. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning sunlight hitting the upper portion of the cliff.
